versions.name: Signs, Signals and Codes
versions.description: Send and read Morse, semaphore, braille and American Sign Language, lay a marked trail for your patrol to follow, decode everyday symbols and traffic signs, and invent a cipher a friend has to crack.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
